title: Offer New World in the theme picker and add /themes/new-world on the Nocturne page layout

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail:
Real renders on all four surfaces, switcher in the hero preview, drift-tested against Nocturne, design checks at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000.

Picker half shipped in #4540 (New World left RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS); the page half shipped as LIVE-2065. The probe script the row named did not exist until LIVE-2058 wrote it.
